part.text:
Fixed. The change is in `lookupKey` (src/db.c:346-349):

```c
if (server.current_client && server.current_client->flag.no_touch &&
    server.current_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand &&
    !(scriptIsRunning() && scriptGetClient()->cmd->proc == touchCommand))
    flags |= LOOKUP_NOTOUCH;
```

**Root cause:** when a script calls `TOUCH`, `lookupKey` checked `server.current_client->cmd` — which during script execution is `EVAL`/`FCALL` (the no-touch client), not the invoked command — so `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH` was always applied and the script's TOUCH had no effect. The fix additionally checks the command currently executed by the script client (whose `cmd` is set per invoked command in `scriptCall`, src/script.c:543), allowing TOUCH to update the LRU/LFU access time while other scripted commands in no-touch mode remain unaffected.

**Verification:** `make` builds cleanly; `unit/introspection-2` (including "TOUCH alters the last access time of a key in no-touch mode"), `unit/scripting`, and `unit/functions` all pass.
